text:
felix (vendor-ops): Heads up from vendor test lab: a subset of H200 boards show thermal derate at sustained 700W in our racks. They recommend slotting lower power profiles for APAC dense clusters.
maya (partnerships): Uh — that could affect our GA messaging. Any impact on H100/B200?
felix (vendor-ops): H100 not affected. B200 has similar derate but only on older firmware. Vendor says patch coming but timeline unclear.
rui (infra): Operational impact: if we accept derate, throughput drop ~15% per rack. We can mitigate with burst routing and cross-region failover but need marketplace SKU notes.
claire (marketplace): Marketplace rules: SKU metadata must include "max sustained TDP" and region-specific caveats. We need to flag APAC SKUs with the derate note before listing. Docs need to be copy-ready.
diego (solutions): For SIs, this matters for perf certs. Recommend we create two perf baselines: "nominal" and "derated" and publish both. SIs can test against the appropriate one.
ops-bot: Reminder: image creation pipeline locks images for 72h once uploaded. Coordinate early to avoid delays.
press-ops: If we delay GA for H200 in APAC, we should still announce NA/EU but include an ops FAQ line about regional variance. Avoid saying "hardware defect"; frame as "regional thermal tuning".
maya (partnerships): Proposed plan: 1) Publish NA/EU announce on May 9 with full H100/H200/B200 claims. 2) APAC gets a "rolling availability" note and a separate APAC GA once vendor patch validated. 3) Marketplace listings include "expected performance window". Thoughts?
rui (infra): Need decision by May 1 to reserve capacity and schedule lab retests. If we go APAC-rolling, I need lab slots May 6-8.
felix (vendor-ops): I'll push vendor for firmware patch ETA and test results by Apr 29. If patch misses, recommend we publish APAC with derated baseline and update later.
claire (marketplace): I'll draft SKU copy and the region caveat template. Will include a short snippet for partner packet: "APAC customers: devices may run in derated mode under sustained load; contact SI for tuned configs."
diego (solutions): Also add a note for customers using Redwood Private (on-prem): we can provide a config guide for power capping and thermal profiles. I'll draft that.
maya (partnerships): Action items: vendor ETA by Apr 29 (felix), lab booking May 6-8 (rui), marketplace draft by Apr 27 (claire), SI perf baselines doc by Apr 26 (diego). If any slip, we'll escalate to execs and prep a leak-response boilerplate.
press-ops: I'll prep the FAQ boilerplate and the "kill switch" language in case we need to pause APAC messaging.
ops-bot: Escalation reminder scheduled: if vendor ETA not posted by Apr 30, create incident channel #hw-derate-escalation.
maya (partnerships): OK thanks team. I'll update partners and set the expectation: NA/EU first, APAC follow-on depending on validation. :white_check_mark:
